name: Google Web Risk API (commercial Safe Browsing)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms (A8): 'Google: tier trusted.' (P067 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Google's Safe Browsing lists through the licensed API: a hit is usually right; a miss reads 'not on Google's lists at <time>', never 'safe' (P067 cond 5). Same upstream lists as Safe Browsing v4: one vote in consensus.

webrisk.description: Google Web Risk API key of the company's Google Cloud project (billing account recorded in licence_allow before corporate use); sent as the 'key' URL parameter and masked by the central redactor (AR01)
webrisk.plan_hint: a company Google Cloud project with billing enabled under the Web Risk terms (class license): record the licence_allow entry for google_webrisk.uris_search with the billing account reference (P067 cond 1)

uris_search.title: Web Risk uris.search (GET /v1/uris:search?threatTypes=...&uri=...): MALWARE, SOCIAL_ENGINEERING, UNWANTED_SOFTWARE verdict of one URL

terms.quote: Google Web Risk (uris.search; class license, A1 BR15) is the corporate path, off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared: a company billing account recorded in licence_allow and key 'webrisk' in config.KNOWN_KEYS.

uris_search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P067 cond 1). Research C0729 (verified_needs_key): keyless calls answer 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'Method doesn't allow unregistered callers', an invalid key 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT 'API key not valid' -> NEEDS_KEY (P067 cond 6). An empty {} answer means no match. Before uris.search, recipient identifiers and token-like values are removed and the URL is reduced to scheme://host/path (P067 cond 4). Hits are cached until their expireTime (<= 30 days), misses 30 min. The hash-prefix Update API (threatLists.computeDiff) is deferred to the backlog (architect floor).
uris_search.licensed_alternative: This is the licensed path: Google Cloud Web Risk terms under the company's billing account (pricing per 1,000 calls after the monthly free allowance).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G03-1 (P067 google_safe_browsing). googleapis.com is a public-suffix namespace: each Google API host is its own provider. Quota = the Google Cloud project's quota and billing (pricing page renders client-side; legal/finance to record the free allowance): no quota block.
